messages:
Sam: Heads up — onboarding run into a weird TS/ESM/CJS interop issue with the JS SDK when targeting edge runtimes. Node ESM works, but in edge worker (Vite+esbuild) consumers see `TS2345` on overloads and `Property 'foo' does not exist on type 'unknown'`.

Jess: Ugh. Any chance it's `moduleResolution` mismatch? node16 vs nodenext bite me here.

Sam: package.json exports uses conditional exports and `types` points to dist/index.d.ts. tsconfig has `module": "esnext", "target":"ES2022", "moduleResolution":"bundler"` (yes, bundler...)

Owen: bundler is often wrong for runtimes that expect ESM types. Try `moduleResolution: \"nodenext\"` and add `typesVersions` to map modern imports -> ./dist/esm

Sam: repro attached: ```json
{\"name\":\"app\",\"type\":\"module\",\"exports\":{\"./sdk\":{\"import\":\"./dist/esm/index.js\",\"default\":\"./dist/cjs/index.js\"}},\"dependencies\":{\"redwood-sdk\":\"^1.2.0\"}}
```

Liya: @Sam can you paste the specific TS error? Overload mismatch usually means index.d.ts has overlapping overloads with any/unknown variance.

Sam: Error: `Argument of type 'unknown' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'.(2345)` on call `client.chat.create(...)` — our overloads allow `string | PromptObject` but when compiled for edge it narrows to unknown.

Jess: That smells like an import shape change — esbuild/rollup might be swapping default/namespace imports. Are you using `esModuleInterop` or `allowSyntheticDefaultImports`? Edge bundlers sometimes rewrite `import * as` to `{}`.

Sam: `esModuleInterop` is true in tsconfig, also `skipLibCheck` is false.

Owen: Two paths: 1) publish a separate `.d.ts` for esm that uses `export default` shape matching package exports, or 2) change overloads to be more explicit using generics like `create<T = string | PromptObject>(input: T extends string ? string : PromptObject)` — ugly but unblocks.

Liya: I can take #1 — add an `esm` folder with ESM-flavored declaration (small wrapper) and update package `types`/`exports` to point at it. Will also add a short sample repo showing tsconfig that works for Cloudflare/Vercel edge.

Sam: Amazing, thx. Also can we document "unknown -> any" tradeoffs? Some teams patch `tsconfig` with `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` off which hides the problem but is scary.

Jess: We should not suggest `any`. Instead add a "Known edge TS pitfalls" doc in DevEx samples — include `moduleResolution`, `typesVersions`, `esModuleInterop`, and common bundler flags.

ci-bot: build #4221 failed: devex/samples/edge-sdk-onboard — `tsc` error 2345 (link: https://ci.example/4221)

Owen: I'll open a PR to add the esm .d.ts and a minimal sample. Assigning to @Liya for docs. Sam, can you drop the minimal repro into the sample repo?

Sam: yep will push in ~30m. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

Liya: added issue #1123 to the backlog and tagged SDK team.

Jess: Nice! once PR lands we should run the sample across node ESM, CJS, and worker CI matrix.

Sam: sounds good. I'll follow up with the failing CI link in the PR.
